scenes.context: 画面中央是安全区，常用画面都放在这里，避免被平台UI遮挡。

practice: The safe zone is where main footage lives.
The restricted zone is for scale gestures—add nothing.
Eyes, title, and captions have their own spots.

Keep it inside the safe zone.
Add elements to the restricted zone.
